About This

  • Cooling & Breathable - The Novilla 12 inch queen size memory foam mattress addes 30% more NanoGel, which will increase the heat absorption capacity, promotes airflow and provides a refreshing cooling effect, thereby delivering an enhanced sleep experience. Enjoy all-night comfort and relaxation, say goodbye hot and restless nights.

This provides a safe and healthy sleep environment for your family. Additionally, it comes with a 10-year protection, ensuring a decade of worry-free.

variants.title: 12-Inch Queen Hybrid Mattress in a Box with Pocket Coils

description.plain:
This 12-inch queen hybrid mattress combines individual power-packed wrapped pocket coils with gel memory foam and layered comfort foams for everyday bedroom use. Its traditional innerspring construction contours to the body, while the ultra plush comfort level and high-density foam create a cushioning sleep surface.

The mattress includes .75 inches of high-density gel memory foam, 1.5 inches of high-density quilt foam, and 1 inch of upholstery-grade comfort support foam. Two perimeter rows of 9-inch, 13-gauge pocketed coils complete the hybrid construction. The white fabric mattress has a solid pattern and a 12-inch profile.

For practical setup, the queen mattress ships compressed in a box. Bring it to the bedroom, remove the plastic wrap, and unroll it; allow 48 hours for the mattress to fully expand after opening. Assembly is not required. A foundation or box spring is available separately, and the mattress is compatible with adjustable bases.

The Chime hybrid mattress is a straightforward everyday choice for a queen bedroom, with a 10-year non-prorated warranty and CertiPUR-US certification. It is offered by Sierra Sleep by Ashley and is available through Curly's Furniture.

**Unique Selling Point:** This queen hybrid mattress combines pocket coils, gel memory foam, and a 12-inch in-a-box design for everyday bedroom use.

- Ultra plush comfort level with traditional innerspring construction

- Adjustable base compatible with a 10-year non-prorated warranty
